info.title: API.SH: Land.com
info.description: The Land.com API from API.SH: public Land.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Land.com broker or seller profile: name, company, description, website, licence, business phones and office address (for companies), logo, portrait, member since, ALC certifications, LandStar wins, awards, social links, listing statistics (active, price and acreage ranges, last 3/5/10 years, all time), featured and sold listings, and every current listing of the broker (`all_listings`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landcom-broker

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The broker number (the digits at the end of a land.com/member/<name>/<id>/ link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Land.com listing: price, acres, beds, baths, home size, listing and update dates, market status, MLS and parcel ids, full address with county and coordinates, highlights, summary, description, directions, price and acreage history, insights, county market benchmarks, amenities by group, photos, virtual tour and video, attachments, auction details, the listing broker (company, licence, website, listing count, ALC certification, member since) and the broker's other listings. Pass `latest=true` with search params to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landcom-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The listing id (the digits at the end of a land.com/property/<title>/<id>/ link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A land.com listing link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Open the first listing of a search instead (with the search params, e.g. state=Texas&sort=newest).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US land, farms, ranches and rural homes for sale on Land.com (formerly Lands of America) by state, county, city or ZIP code, with property type, keyword feature (creek, pond...), price, acreage, home size, beds, baths, house or no house, status (including under contract, sold and off-market), owner financing, mineral rights, media and sort, or any Land.com search link. Each result has id, link, title, types, price, price per acre, recent price change, acres, beds, baths, home size, address, county, coordinates, status, auction and sale dates, media flags, photos, summary and the listing broker (name, company, office phone, profile); the place's market figures come with it. 25 per page, up to 20 pages (as the site); pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landcom-search

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state name or two-letter code.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name (with `state`, instead of a county).

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A 5-digit ZIP code instead of a place.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property type: undeveloped, farms, ranches, residential, hunting, lakefront, riverfront, beachfront, waterfront, recreational, timberland, commercial, horse.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: A feature word the listing mentions, e.g. creek, pond, barn.

parameters.name: house
parameters.description: Only land with a house, or only without.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: available, under_contract, sold, off_market (default: available and under contract).

parameters.name: has_virtual_tour
parameters.description: Only listings with a virtual tour.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Any land.com search link (or its path) instead of the params above, e.g. land.com/Hill-County-TX/ranches/.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (25 per page, up to 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
